architecture.episode: build_episode freezes recorded events into an immutable dependency DAG; duplicate node ids refused; complete requires a terminal event
architecture.world: build_world seals an episode into a WorldTape bound to an ExecutionSignature; hidden scores live on the tape and never enter the frontier
architecture.public_observation: frontier projection exposes only progress facts (attempts, error kinds, budget, legal actions); no scores, best branch, or result-revealing ids
architecture.replay: WorldReplay requires pre-result slot commitment, then open_batch -> settle_step -> close_batch; results cross the barrier only when every step is supported; mismatch classes: signature_mismatch (model/endpoint/runtime/tools), input_mismatch (skill drift or wrong input fingerprint), dependency_not_observed, out_of_support, incomplete, timeout
architecture.trace: trace_run/failure_attribution navigate the ledger by event_seq cursor with scope denial indistinguishable from absence; deleted payloads are evidence_unavailable; absent terminal failure -> root_cause=unknown with hypotheses separated from observation
architecture.stop: settle_stop refuses to substitute exploration stop for acceptance/review gates

not_established: real_policy_runner_isolation (process/container boundary; policies run in-process in tests)
live_ui_trace_surface (trace navigation verified at API level only)
